entities.summary: Gunther Rolf Kress MBE was a linguist and semiotician. Best known for his work with Bob Hodge, he is considered one of the leading theorists in critical discourse analysis, social semiotics and multimodality, particularly in relation to their educational implications. Kress has been described as "one of the leading academics of the early 21st century".
